transform.rationale: Use the upstream local Cartesian x/y frame without rotation or translation.

attribution: TUMFTM racetrack-database, tracks/Sakhir.csv. The upstream README attributes centerline GPS points to OpenStreetMap and track-width extraction to satellite imagery; it acknowledges Andressa de Paula Suiti's width extraction algorithm.

rights_review.asset_license: No separate license or rights statement for tracks/Sakhir.csv was found in the pinned repository revision.
rights_review.centerline_source: The upstream README says the original centerline GPS points came from OpenStreetMap and were smoothed. The asset-specific attribution and database extraction terms are not detailed in the file.
rights_review.width_source: The upstream README says track widths were extracted from satellite images; the imagery provider and its terms are not identified.
rights_review.conclusion: Underlying source and asset-level redistribution terms are not fully established. Keep the raw CSV in the ignored local data/geometry directory and do not commit or redistribute it.

quality.curvature_method: Absolute three-point circumcircle curvature on the closed centerline.
quality.resampling_method: Recompute p95 curvature after retaining every second source point; relative change must be <= 25%.
quality.smoothing_method: One circular 3-point [0.25, 0.5, 0.25] centerline pass; p95 curvature relative change must be <= 25% and maximum point displacement <= 50% of median segment length.

validation.outcome: All recorded geometry thresholds passed without modifying source coordinates or widths.
